title: 7 Daily Affirmation Apps to Boost Positivity in 2026 (Measured on the App Store)
description: The best daily affirmation apps in 2026, copied in form from Happier Human's roundup and measured on the US App Store on 26 Nov 2026: I am (4.83, 740,559 ratings), Motivation (4.82, 1,081,717), Mantra, ThinkUp, Gratitude Plus, Unique Daily Affirmations — and Anicca, listed honestly with its real early numbers.
markdown:
By Anicca · November 2026

Are you looking for an easier way to stay consistent with daily affirmations and positive thinking?

**Short answer:** The best daily affirmation apps in 2026, measured on the US App Store on 26 November 2026, are I am - Daily Affirmations (4.83 stars from 740,559 ratings), Motivation - Daily quotes (4.82 from 1,081,717 ratings) and Mantra - Daily Affirmations (4.84 from 34,508 ratings) for proven scale, with ThinkUp, Unique Daily Affirmations and Gratitude Plus as smaller, well-rated options — and Anicca, our own app, listed honestly at the end with its real, early numbers (5.0 stars from 1 rating). Every rating and count in this article was read from the public App Store listing on the date above; we do not repeat numbers we could not verify.

*Disclosure: Anicca is our app. Following the form of Happier Human's roundup "13 Daily Affirmation Apps to Boost Positivity in 2026", we list the apps in the same numbered format, we state our own app's small numbers plainly instead of ranking it first, and we excluded apps whose current store numbers we could not verify on the day (for example Shine, whose search result returned no rating count).*

**Key takeaways:**

- Building a healthier mindset takes regular practice, and an app makes the practice easy to stick with on busy days.
- The measured leaders are not close: Motivation holds over one million US ratings and I am over 740,000, while every other verified app here is under 35,000.
- Ratings are tightly clustered (4.75–4.86 for the established apps), so the real difference is library size, reminders and whether the words change with your state.
- A free download is available at the end, in the same place the winner puts it: a bundle of daily affirmations you can use alongside any of these apps.

## What are Affirmations (and Why Do They Matter)

Affirmations are positive statements you tell yourself to change your thoughts about certain things. If you are in a stressful situation, you can use an affirmation like "I can do this" or "I am better than this problem" to lift your spirits and turn the odds in your favour.

In the same way, affirmations help you overcome self-sabotaging behaviours like self-criticism, procrastination and overindulgence. Through these words, you help yourself get back on your feet and continue.

Now, let's take a look at the apps that will help you get some daily affirmations into your day — each one checked on its public App Store page on 26 November 2026.

## 1. ThinkUp: Positive Affirmations

**ThinkUp** is the leading app for recording affirmations in your own voice. You can personalize your affirmations by recording them with your voice and adding music and an image you like, then play them back as a daily practice.

The app offers a premium version that gives you unlimited access to premium features such as an unlimited number of affirmations, background music, an auto-stop timer and playlist hashtags. Its measured US App Store rating on 26 November 2026 was 4.75 stars from 7,523 ratings.

**Apple Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id906660772**

## 2. I am - Daily Affirmations

This affirmation app aims to help rewire your brain and change negative thoughts into positive ones. Affirming your dreams and ambitions aims to boost your confidence and self-esteem, and to help you believe in yourself and realize what you are capable of.

You can choose which type of affirmations to receive, alter your daily intentions depending on what you need, and set reminders for when you will receive them. It is the scale leader among pure affirmation apps: 4.83 stars from 740,559 US ratings, measured on 26 November 2026, and it also ranked #1 in the US App Store search for "daily affirmations" in our 26 November 2026 measurement.

**Apple Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id874656917**

## 3. Mantra - Daily Affirmations

**Mantra** delivers a daily affirmation every morning and lets you share the words as images. In our keyword measurement on 26 November 2026 (OwlASO, US), Mantra held the broadest keyword set of any affirmation app — "affirmation", "daily affirmations", "best affirmation", "top affirmation" and more — which is one reason it keeps being recommended.

Its measured US App Store rating was 4.84 stars from 34,508 ratings on 26 November 2026.

**Apple Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id1202851636**

## 4. Motivation - Daily Quotes

Instead of affirmations, this app sends you an inspirational and motivational quote daily. You can select a number of categories, set images with quotes as your background, and change the fonts and colours depending on your taste. A premium subscription removes advertisements and unlocks all themes and categories.

By raw count it is the largest app in this list: 4.82 stars from 1,081,717 US ratings, measured on 26 November 2026.

**Apple Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id876080126**

## 5. Unique Daily Affirmations

**Unique Daily Affirmations** is the least complicated affirmation app you will ever find. Once you have downloaded the app, you hold down the large button to see your positive affirmation for the day, and its creators suggest saying the affirmation out loud in front of a mirror.

Its measured US App Store rating was 4.76 stars from 19,856 ratings on 26 November 2026.

**Apple Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id418693319**

## 6. Gratitude Plus – Journal

Gratitude Plus provides daily prompts like "What made you smile today?" You answer with a word or a paragraph, and when you read your previous entries back, they act as positive affirmations written in your own words.

It holds the highest rating in this list: 4.86 stars from 21,474 US ratings, measured on 26 November 2026.

**Apple Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id1447851477**

## 7. Anicca - Daily Affirmations

Anicca is our app, so we give you its real numbers first: 5.0 stars from 1 US rating on 26 November 2026. It is early, and we will not pretend otherwise.

What it does differently is the words themselves: instead of a fixed catalogue, Anicca's home screen keeps changing the words it shows you on its own, choosing the next intervention from your onboarding answers. If you want an affirmation app that sends you positive affirmations every day and changes with your state, this is the one we are building — and its current size is exactly why your early rating would be visible.

**Apple Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id6755129214**

## Free Download: Daily Affirmations Bundle

This Daily Affirmations Bundle is filled with uplifting affirmations designed to help you build confidence, improve your mindset, and stay motivated throughout the day. It is a simple way to surround yourself with positivity and encouragement whenever you need it.

The bundle is the Anicca app itself, free on the App Store: the affirmations above, delivered daily and changing with you. Download it and start creating a more positive daily routine today: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id6755129214

## Final Words on Positive Affirmation Apps

Affirmations are a lot more beneficial than you might think. They develop your self-awareness, cultivate your positivity, nurture your sense of gratitude, and improve your overall happiness and life satisfaction.

The affirmation apps we listed above can help you achieve that state of positivity. They differ in style, format and features, but they all have the same goal: to help you become a better, happier version of yourself. The measured difference in 2026 is scale — Motivation and I am hold hundreds of thousands more ratings than the rest — and the open difference is whether the words stay fixed or change with you.

Have you already tried some of the apps above? Or is your favourite affirmation app not included on the list? Tell us — we re-measure this list from the public store pages, and we will check any app you name.

Think positive. Never back down. Let positive affirmations feed your soul with encouragement and motivation.

## Frequently asked questions

### What is the best daily affirmation app in 2026?

By measured US App Store ratings count, Motivation - Daily quotes (1,081,717 ratings, 4.82 stars) and I am - Daily Affirmations (740,559 ratings, 4.83 stars) lead, both measured on 26 November 2026. For recording affirmations in your own voice, ThinkUp is the specialist option.

### Which affirmation app has the highest rating?

Of the apps verified on 26 November 2026, Gratitude Plus – Journal held the highest rating at 4.86 stars (21,474 ratings), followed by Mantra at 4.84 and I am at 4.83.

### Are these affirmation apps free?

Every app in the comparison table was listed as Free on its US App Store page on 26 November 2026. Most offer a premium subscription that unlocks the full library or removes ads; the free tier is enough to start a daily practice.

### How was this list measured?

Each app's rating and ratings count were read from its public US App Store listing on 26 November 2026, and keyword positions were measured the same day with OwlASO and our App Store search measurement. Apps whose numbers could not be verified that day were excluded and the exclusion is stated in the disclosure.
